payload.rationale: The obligation asks whether the Daily Max mg/L value 50 establishes an enforceable numeric discharge limit or whether TSS monitoring is report-only with no applicable numeric limit. The packet shows numeric 50 in the Daily Max mg/L column and "Report" in the 30-Day Avg mg/L column, but it does not include permit text defining how to interpret this asymmetric pairing. Adjacent pollutant rows provide analogies for all-numeric mg/L limits, all-Report mg/L rows, and N/A-heavy rows, yet no comparison row pairs "Report" with a numeric value in the mg/L limitation columns. Without an in-packet rule or matching precedent, the burden to establish either that 50 is an enforceable limit (ACCEPT) or that TSS is entirely report-only despite the numeric cell (REJECT) is not met. Per P5, unsupported uncertainty is preferred to unsupported semantic closure.
